name: teak-raycast
description: Save ideas fast, search your Teak cards, and access favorites directly from Raycast.
author: praveenjuge

ai.instructions: Use search-cards or get-recent to find Teak cards, list-tags to discover the user's tags, and list-folders to see their folders (manual and smart). Narrow search-cards with tag, folder, type, favorited, archived, done ("done" or "todo" for links they have or haven't read, watched or bought), mood (images), and dates. Pass similarTo with a card id to find cards close in meaning to it, and sort "shuffle" for a random sample. Archived cards, and cards tagged secret or hidden, are left out of searches unless asked for: use archived for the first and tag secret or hidden for the second. Use get-card for follow-up detail on a specific card, save-card when the user explicitly asks to save something, favorite-card to toggle favorites, and update-card to add or remove tags, change notes, mark a link done, archive or unarchive a card, or add it to a folder. Always confirm mutating actions before running them.

evals.input: @teak show me the articles I haven't read yet
@teak show me a few random things I saved
@teak add card 4a2f9c1e7b3d5a8e0c6f1b2d4e7a9c3b5 to my Reading list folder
